root_cause.text: The vulnerability is caused by an off-by-one error in the `dlm_match_regions()` function of the OCFS2 DLM subsystem, where the loop condition `j <= qr->qr_numregions` incorrectly allows iteration beyond the valid bounds of the `qr_regions` array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff in `fs/ocfs2/dlm/dlmdomain.c` changes the loop condition from `j <= qr->qr_numregions` to `j < qr->qr_numregions`, which aligns with the CVE description stating the original loop used `<=` instead of `<`, causing it to read "one entry past the valid range of qr_regions".

intent_record.intent_summary: Corrects an off-by-one error in the region iteration loop to prevent accessing memory beyond the allocated region array.
intent_record.what: Modified the loop condition in dlm_match_regions from 'j <= qr->qr_numregions' to 'j < qr->qr_numregions'.
intent_record.how: Ensures the loop iterates only over valid region indices (0 to count-1), preventing out-of-bounds memory access when comparing region names.
